profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Digital Harbor
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: As a Software Engineer at Digital Harbor, I thrive in a startup-like environment, leading a subteam to integrate products across the company. I focus on frontend development and coordinate with Bolivian colleagues using my Spanish skills. With a strong foundation in web programming, software design, data science, AI, and computer vision from my internship at Lucid Software and previous role at BYU Broadcasting—where I maintained high-traffic websites, built smart TV apps, and deployed serverless applications—I’m passionate about tackling complex challenges and delivering innovative solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a subteam in integrating employer productivity products across the company, driving collaboration in a dynamic, startup-like environment.
- Coordinated with Bolivian colleagues using Spanish skills, fostering effective international teamwork and accelerating project delivery.
- Developed innovative features, boosting efficiency in productivity solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Handled website maintenance and updates as one of the primary maintainers for BYUtv and BYUradio websites with over 5 million unique monthly visitors.
- Orchestrated daily updates to the website using VueJS, NuxtJS, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Git.
- Helped in building a unified code base for multiple Smart TV application platforms, including Xbox, Xfinity X1, Samsung, LG, and Vizio.
- Created new web media player UIs for the website and smart TV apps, integrating with VideoJS and Shaka player and supporting HLS streaming, DRM, and Adobe Analytics. 
- Implemented new features and resolved bugs in preparation for launching the new BYUtv Android app using Kotlin, Android Studio, and Git.
- Deployed and maintained full-stack serverless web applications in AWS using S3, Fargate, DynamoDB, CloudFormation, and the AWS CDK.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: South Jordan, Utah, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed new features and fixed bugs for Visual Activities in the Lucid suite using Angular, TypeScript, Html, CSS, and Git
- Collaborated with product managers, designers, and other engineers in a fast-paced agile development environment to deliver user-focused enhancements
- Communicated effectively across various levels of the organization to ensure alignment on requirements and designs
- Applied feedback from teammates to rapidly improve code quality and deepen knowledge of the front-end codebase and best practices
